members.name: FromImage
members.signature: public static Texture2D FromImage(Aperture.Image image, bool mipmaps = false, bool srgb = true, TextureFormat format = TextureFormat.RGBA8, TextureEncodeQuality quality = TextureEncodeQuality.Balanced)

docs.summary: Creates a [`Texture2D`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture2D) from an already decoded Rgba8 image. With mipmaps it filters Trilinear, without Bilinear. sRGB marks it as colour, decoded when sampled, off for normal maps and masks. A compressed `format` filters the mips on the CPU and compresses every level at `quality`.

members.name: FromMipChain
members.signature: public static Texture2D FromMipChain(IReadOnlyList<byte[]> levels, int width, int height, bool srgb, TextureFormat format, TextureEncodeQuality quality = TextureEncodeQuality.Balanced)

docs.summary: Creates a [`Texture2D`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture2D) from an RGBA8 mip chain, level 0 first, stored as `format`. Compressed formats encode every level at `quality`, R8 keeps red. With more than one level it filters Trilinear.
